referenceSources.description:
A striking red Ferrari 550 GTS, prepared by Prodrive for GT competition, is parked on a brick courtyard in front of a residential-style building. The car’s livery features the number 88, sponsor logos such as Sunoco Race Fuels, Michelin, and Champagne French Bakery Café, and a large rear wing bearing the Care Racing Development branding. Its low stance, racing wheels, and aerodynamic modifications highlight its track-focused design.

This Prodrive variant of the Ferrari 550 Maranello was developed for endurance racing, including events like the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Based on the road-going 550 Maranello designed by Pininfarina, the GTS version incorporates competition brakes, tuned suspension, and lightweight body panels. The combination of Ferrari’s front-engine V12 and Prodrive’s racing expertise produced a formidable GT racer, exemplified by this #88 entry.
